nodes.label: Default checked-in UI-only build
nodes.rationale: Safe normal workflow for UI, CSS, client JavaScript, templates, preset-library, and docs because it reuses checked-in embedded chart data and does not read a local Terra Invicta install.

nodes.label: Local-game-data rebuild
nodes.rationale: Kept explicit because it reads machine-local Terra Invicta template data and regenerates catalogs and published assets.

nodes.label: No full refresh or deep extraction workflow
nodes.rationale: No deeper extraction workflow exists; if added later it must stay behind a clearly named explicit option or script instead of the default build.
nodes.norm_label: no full refresh or deep extraction workflow

nodes.label: Generated and external data policy
nodes.rationale: Generated artifacts and parsed external data are opaque during routine work; source builders and source client modules should be reviewed instead.

nodes.label: Source of truth
nodes.rationale: Routine edits should target source builders, source client modules, templates, styles, i18n, and preset-library input rather than generated published copies.

nodes.label: Deploy workflow
nodes.rationale: npm run deploy is excluded from routine validation because it preserves publishing behavior and may commit and push generated files.

nodes.label: Search and review scope
nodes.rationale: Routine search should prioritize source paths and exclude generated outputs, dependencies, caches, virtualenvs, and test artifacts.

nodes.label: Default checked-in UI-only build
nodes.rationale: The default build avoids machine-local game data by rebuilding the dashboard shell and browser modules while reusing checked-in embedded catalog data.

nodes.label: WSL PATH guard
nodes.rationale: The helper verifies python, node, npm, and npx resolve to Linux/WSL tools rather than Windows .exe or .cmd tools under /mnt/c.

nodes.label: Local Terra Invicta data rebuild
nodes.rationale: Catalog and site regeneration from local Templates is explicit because it depends on machine-local Steam paths and game data.

nodes.label: Template source and game version detection
nodes.norm_label: template source and game version detection

nodes.label: No separate full refresh or deep extraction mode
nodes.rationale: --from-game is the explicit full catalog rebuild; future expensive extraction should be behind a separate named option or script.
nodes.norm_label: no separate full refresh or deep extraction mode

nodes.label: Generated output and deployment scope
nodes.rationale: The deploy script stages only generated output paths and leaves other local changes untouched.

nodes.label: Module layout goal
nodes.rationale: The module layout should keep feature work possible without rebuilding a hidden monolith across many files.

nodes.label: Dependency direction
nodes.rationale: Preferred dependency flow is downward from composition and UI toward lower-level state and calculation helpers.

nodes.label: chart/interaction.js
nodes.rationale: Legend and compact chart-guide copy live with interaction because the text must stay synchronized with chart semantics and interaction behavior.

nodes.label: Ship Designer grouping inside Simulation Conditions
nodes.norm_label: ship designer grouping inside simulation conditions

nodes.label: Circular import guard
nodes.rationale: The graph verifier fails on circular imports to protect native ESM initialization order and avoid re-creating cross-module cycles.
